name: Mapping model units to visual neurons reveals population code for social behavior
description: Supervised the conversion of courtship sessions of male fruit flies with different LC neuron types silenced, combining their video, SLEAP pose tracking, song and behavior, and of two-photon calcium imaging of those neuron types' responses to visual stimuli.
Resulted in the publication of **331 GB** of fruit fly calcium imaging data on the NIH data archive.
